name: Pickup
description: A drop of pulp landing: one sine chirping up an octave, $fifth.down to $fifth, over 70ms and gone — the plip a droplet makes, not a beep. It fires in streams (a magnet pulls a whole field in at once), so it is built to pile up the way rain does: a pure tone with nothing above it, low enough to sit under the weapons, a pitch that differs drop to drop, and no more than a dozen of it a second.
